subject: Possibility to include gene_id and transcript_id in output

messages.author: e6a3de308bc276e9
messages.subject: Possibility to include gene_id and transcript_id in output
parts:
Hello. Is it possible to include gene_id and transcript_id in the output matrix. The command I tried:

featureCounts ... -t exon -g gene_id -g transcript_id ...

does not seem to work. I am not worried about counting, it can count based on gene_id, but just to also include other identifiers in the output. Thanks.

V
